cues.text: Logs / History keeps every run, yours and your colleagues’, with its screenshots.
Search by order number, PLU, error code or operator. The filters narrow the list down, e.g. by status.
Click a run to open it: what happened, its products and steps, who ran it and when.
The screenshots are the run’s evidence. Click one to see it full size; the arrows show the others.
Each run ends with a status, shown in colour. The Status filter lists the runs of one status.
Completed: the run did all its steps. The order was placed and approved, or the approval was done.
Awaiting approval: the order is placed, and someone with a backoffice account still has to approve it.
Failed: the run hit a problem. The Error column shows its code; the run’s details show the step and a screenshot.
Stopped: someone pressed Stop before the run finished. “Check the order” means it may already have been placed.
That’s it. Open this walkthrough again any time with Walkthrough, at the top of the page.
